description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one, and neither can be empty.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length and does not support base64).

description.zh:

* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。

description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one, and neither can be empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云营业执照识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于识别营业执照上的公司名称、地址、主体类型、法定代表人、注册资金、组成形式、成立日期等关键信息的场景。 * 泛营业执照包含民办非企业登记证书、社会团体法人登记证书、事业单位法人证书。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |全字段识别|智能识别营业执照上所包含的全部字段。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|企事业名称、法人代表等文字信息准确率超过95%，营业执照注册号等数字信息准确率超过98%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [企业资质识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=assets&subtype=blicense#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[营业执照识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn_20211103184836_0975%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeBusinessLicense?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 请保证整张营业执照内容及其边缘包含在图像内。
  • 本能力会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
| |相关能力|
  • [云市场营业执照识别。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi013592.html?spm=5176.730005.result.41.7fc03524S3wFYv&innerSource=search_%E8%90%A5%E4%B8%9A%E6%89%A7%E7%85%A7#sku=yuncode759200000)
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Business License Recognition is an OCR text recognition product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud. It is suitable for scenarios that require extracting key information from business licenses, such as company name, address, entity type, legal representative, registered capital, organizational form, and incorporation date. * The term "general business license" includes certificates such as the Certificate of Registration for Non-Governmental Non-Enterprise Organizations, Certificate of Registration for Legal Persons of Social Organizations, and Certificate of Registration for Legal Persons of Public Institutions. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over many years and offer several advantages: stable service, simple operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Classification | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Full-Field Recognition | Intelligently recognizes all fields present on a business license. | | Multi-Type Coverage | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including those that are blurry, unevenly lit, perspective-distorted, or set against arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Text information such as enterprise or institution names and legal representatives achieves an accuracy rate exceeding 95%. Numeric information such as business license registration numbers achieves an accuracy rate exceeding 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Enterprise Credential Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience the recognition capability of this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=assets&subtype=blicense#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Business License Recognition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn_20211103184836_0975%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota that you can use for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; in this case, the system will automatically deduct fees based on actual usage under the "[pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)" billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeBusinessLicense?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration and development. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see: [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • Ensure the entire business license content, including its edges, is fully contained within the image.
  • This capability automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but such conditions may reduce accuracy. Whenever possible, use clear, glare-free, and undistorted images.
| | Related Capabilities |
  • [Alibaba Cloud Marketplace Business License Recognition](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi013592.html?spm=5176.730005.result.41.7fc03524S3wFYv&innerSource=search_%E8%90%A5%E4%B8%9A%E6%89%A7%E7%85%A7#sku=yuncode759200000).
|
